summary: Each y has a monic minimal polynomial over ℤ_ℓ of degree ≤ r (a root of unity of order ℓ^a − 1 lies in the unramified extension of degree a); X^L − 1 vanishes on M, and so does the product of the minimal polynomials, monic of degree ≤ N·r.

steps.claim: For y ∈ M: the minimal polynomial of y over ℤ_ℓ is monic of degree ≤ r: y is the image of an element of the Witt vectors of 𝔽_{ℓ^a} (exists_flatFq_root), whose rank over ℤ_ℓ is a ≤ r.
steps.lean:
have H y c : (minpoly _ y).Monic ∧ (minpoly ℤ_[ℓ] y).natDegree ≤ r := by
    choose f hf hx using k y c
    obtain ⟨a, rfl : wittToQpBar _ = _⟩ := exists_flatFq_root (f := f.toPNat hf.1) _ _ fun _ ↦ hx
    grw [algHom_eq _ wittToQpBar_injective, natDegree_le,
      KummerChart.JumpLattice.finrank_wittFq]; use monic (.of_finite ..), hf.2

steps.claim: K holds for X^L − 1 (each y^{ℓ^a − 1} = 1 and ℓ^a − 1 divides L) and for the product of the minimal polynomials of the y ∈ M, monic of degree ≤ |M|·r ≤ N·r, both vanishing on M (h).
